coverage_claim: WM-ECO-022 covers one governed subscription from identity, version, profile, agreement and plan bindings through participants, items, seats, beneficiaries, entitlements, usage allowances, recurring economics, billing and renewal schedules, invoice and payment references, service lifecycle, cancellation, evidence, access, retention and loss-aware projections. Jurisdiction and sector profiles, legal determinations and independent external review remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a recurring commercial-relationship aggregate. Contract, party, account, plan or offering, product, service, entitlement, order, invoice, payment, usage event, meter reading, service instance, support case and records remain external masters.

decisions.concept: Subscription, contract, plan, membership and entitlement
decisions.rationale: The subscription binds an agreement and versioned plan to recurring operational and economic context; it is neither the reusable plan nor the legal contract, membership identity or entitlement grant.
Commercial Contract is a plausible parent reference, but no frozen canonical relation grants ownership, mutation or cascade authority.
Provider, subscriber, customer, payer, beneficiary, seat holder, administrator, agent and sponsor remain separate, source-qualified roles and may be different parties.

decisions.concept: Agreement, entitlement, provisioning, service, billing, payment and usage axes
decisions.rationale: Each axis preserves independent state, authority, evidence and time; active, paid or renewed status cannot prove the others.
Recurring, one-time, seat, usage, tiered, volume, tax, discount, credit, proration, refund and overage values remain distinct and source-qualified.
Anchor, timezone, interval, in-advance or arrears basis, exceptions, count or end, invoice and due times stay explicit; a schedule neither invoices nor charges.
Request, notice, at-period-end selection, immediate effect, termination completion, entitlement revocation, final bill, refund, export and deletion remain separately attributable.
EU consumer and digital-content rules, UNIDROIT Principles and EPC direct-debit rules are scoped profiles rather than universal subscription law.
TM Forum, schema.org, ODRL, EPC, RFC, PROV, DQV, ISO 4217 and OpenAPI cover different facets and never replace the canonical aggregate.

One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison locally without tools or new research facts; assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-022 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ECO-006 is only a parent signal and no model relation is canonically approved for this aggregate.

Boundary hold: subscription, contract, party, account, plan, offering, product, service, entitlement, order, invoice, payment, usage event, meter reading, support case and records must retain separate identities.
State-axis hold: agreement, entitlement, provisioning, availability, billing, payment, usage, support and cancellation states and clocks must never be silently collapsed.

Economic hold: every recurring, one-time, seat, usage, tiered, tax, discount, credit, proration, refund and overage value requires currency, quantity or usage basis, period, source, approval and uncertainty.

Temporal hold: signup, contract, trial, activation, service, usage, billing, invoice, payment, renewal, notice, cancellation, termination, observation, ingestion and knowledge time remain distinct; timestamps require seconds and timezone offset.
Cancellation hold: request, notice, effective cancellation, termination completion, entitlement revocation, final billing, refund, export and data disposition require separate evidence and authority.

Authority hold: contract formation, plan or price change, charging, invoicing, entitlement grant or revocation, renewal, cancellation, termination, disclosure and disposition require delegated accountable authority.
Jurisdiction hold: EU consumer and digital-content rules, UNIDROIT Principles and EPC direct-debit rules are scoped profiles; national and sector rules require separate validation.

Interoperability hold: every TM Forum, schema.org, ODRL, EPC, RFC 5545, RFC 3339, PROV, DQV, ISO 4217 and OpenAPI projection requires version pins, conformance evidence and information-loss declarations.
Privacy hold: personal, usage, device, location, entitlement, payment, delinquency, support and cancellation data require purpose-bound access, minimization, portability and retention controls.
deferred_research: Canonically approve the WM-ECO-006 relation and register Party, Account, Product, Service, Catalogue, Plan, Entitlement, Order, Invoice, Payment, Usage, Support and Records edges.
Create telecom, utility, insurance, healthcare, media, SaaS, membership, transport and jurisdiction-specific profiles.
Conformance-test plan changes, entitlement limits, recurrence, usage, billing, proration, renewal, cancellation and projections against concrete implementations.
Validate organization-specific contract, pricing, billing, payment, entitlement, renewal, cancellation, privacy, retention and disposition policies.
Obtain authorized legal, tax, consumer and payment review before making jurisdiction-specific claims.
Obtain independent external research review before promoting beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
